name: Slovenia: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Slovenia package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed consent procedure present, on template version 2.0, with the Slovenian Member State fields and a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 Slovenian recruitment material present for every advertisement, invitation, script or other item participants will see or hear.
L1 trial-specific Slovenian PIS and ICF present, blank, with version number and date.
One population-specific Slovenian document set per population set whose trigger is true; every enrolled age group and decision-maker has a document pathway.
items.applies_when: any population_sets trigger other than adult_patients

items.check: Other Slovenian participant-facing materials (cards, instructions, diaries, questionnaires and similar) present when used, in the appropriate CTIS category.
For every Slovenian site: M1 CV, M2 declaration of interest and N1 site suitability statement.
O1 proof of insurance or guarantee covering sponsor and investigator liability.
P1 participant compensation and P2 financing description present.
R1 data-protection statement with the Slovenian content present.
S1 biological-samples compliance document present.
Slovenian cover letter and Slovenian protocol synopsis present (English synopsis too in a multinational application).
Combined national fee paid to JAZMP and proof retained.
Every participant- or representative-facing document is in Slovenian.
Cover letter and synopsis in Slovenian; administrative Part II documents in Slovenian or English.
Language decision for sites in the bilingual areas recorded (DECISIONS.md D2).
items.applies_when: a Slovenian site is in a bilingual area

items.check: Blank PIS, ICF, assent, pregnancy and other consent forms and recruitment materials contain no signatures.
N1 dated and signed by the person authorised to confirm the site's suitability; no signature presented as required on M1 or M2; insurance evidence issued by the insurer or guarantor.
Each Slovenian site and principal investigator appears consistently in CTIS, M1, M2 and N1.
Protocol number, EU trial number, sponsor, titles and document versions consistent across all documents, the CTIS record and the document list.
Reimbursement and payment amounts and conditions identical in P1 and the participant documents.
Damage cover and claim route in the participant documents match O1.
Controllers, legal bases, recipients, transfers and retention identical in R1, the participant documents and the protocol.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents; optional use separated from main-trial consent.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
The Slovenian synopsis does not contradict the PIS.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain the Slovenian national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Slovenia is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document; fee proof outside Part II.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Slovenia receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules applicable from 18 June 2024).
Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Only the versions intended for assessment are uploaded; tracked changes, comments and hidden text removed from clean files.
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
